away.summary: The Wild (7-3-2) are coming off a 5-1 win at Seattle and did not hold a morning skate. Calvin Pickard is projected to start in goal for the second time this season, with Jesper Wallstedt listed as the backup. The lineup includes several scratches (David Spacek, Rieger Lorenz, Mason Shaw) and key injuries to Faber, both Folignos, and Gustavsson.

home.summary: The Canucks (2-9-1) are struggling early in the season and held an optional morning skate. Leevi Merilainen is projected to start ahead of Kevin Lankinen. Liam Ohgren returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch on Thursday, while Guillaume Brisebois replaces Jamie Oleksiak and Luke Schenn returns after being scratched for Victor Mancini.
